02 / Twice-weekly edit

THIS WEEK,
BEYOND THE OBVIOUS

Three free or unusually good-value London events, selected for access, local character and a story worth following.

01 Free

Sat 3 Oct · 10:00–17:00

Free Heritage Buses on Route 106

Routemasters, RTs and other preserved buses from the 1950s to 1970s carry passengers free between Finsbury Park and Ash Grove, with real conductors and no booking.

Where
Route 106: Finsbury Park to Ash Grove, Islington and Hackney
Access
Drop in
Check details ↗
02 Free

Sat 3 Oct – Sun 4 Oct

Croydon Harvest and Walnut Fair

A free town-centre festival revives Croydon's 1314 Walnut Fair through farmyard circus, folk traditions, local history, global dance and participatory street art.

Where
Croydon town centre, Croydon
Access
Drop in
Check details ↗
03 Free

Sun 4 Oct · 10:30–16:30

Little Holland House Open Day

Step inside Frank Dickinson's self-built Arts and Crafts home, where his handmade furniture, paintings, carvings, metalwork and Art Nouveau interiors remain in place.

Where
Little Holland House, Sutton
Access
Booking recommended
Check details ↗
